Qué es, de dónde salen las cifras, cómo: What it is, where the figures come from, how each item is calculated and how it is validated against the Income statement.
Responde: <b>¿qué líneas de negocio gene: It answers: which business lines generate the margin and which ones consume it, which one does the company depend on? It takes the result that Bufins already calculates by line and shows it as an income statement by line, with the revenue mix, the margins and the comparison with last year.
Qué línea es la líder y cuánto pesa en l: Which line is the leader and how much it weighs in revenue.
Qué líneas aportan a la utilidad operaci: Which lines contribute to operating profit and which do not.
La lectura con IA: rentabilidad, concent: The AI reading: profitability, concentration and recommended action.
El estado de resultados completo de cada: The complete income statement of each line, from revenue to net profit.
La validación contra el Estado de result: The validation against the Income statement (P&L).
Export to Excel, PDF and email.
Se elige la empresa, el escenario y un <: Choose the company, the scenario and a range of months (with the usual shortcuts: current year, last 6 months, etc.). The figures of the range are added up and compared with the same range of last year. You can also choose the color palette of the report and its exports.
El resultado se organiza en <b>pestañas<: The result is organized in tabs: the key indicators always stay at the top and each tab shows its part — Summary (revenue mix, contribution to profit and margins), Income statement (the matrix by line and the summary), Sales lines (only if the company uses them) and Analysis and comments (AI reading and management comments). When exporting to PDF or image, all the sections are included.
Ingresos y utilidad operacional (con su: Revenue and operating profit (with their variation against last year), operating margin and the leading line with its weight in revenue.
Barras apiladas mes a mes: cuánto aporta: Stacked bars month by month: how much each line contributes to revenue and how the mix changes.
Las líneas ordenadas por su utilidad ope: The lines ordered by their operating profit, with their operating margin.
Margen bruto, operacional y neto de cada: Gross, operating and net margin of each line and of the total.
Ingresos, costo de ventas, utilidad brut: Revenue, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, operating profit, EBITDA, non-operating result, profit before tax, tax and net profit, one column per line plus the total, and the margins.
Participación en ingresos y en la utilid: Share of revenue and of operating profit, and variation against last year.
Solo si la empresa maneja líneas de vent: Only if the company uses sales lines (the “Type” of each product or service): indicators (how many lines, the leader, concentration of the top three, largest growth and largest drop), a pie chart with the share of each sales line in revenue, the stacked monthly evolution and a table with revenue, share, previous year, variation, contribution to the change, monthly average and best month.
Notas del equipo sobre el cierre; se pue: Team notes about the close; you can indicate which line each one refers to.
De la tabla del modelo <code>ModeloLinea: From the model table ModeloLineasNegocio, the result of the Business Lines model. The report does not run the model: there is data only after it has been run in Model Execution (that is why it carries the “Bufins model information” capsule).
<b>Las líneas son propias de cada empres: The lines are specific to each company. The model stores each account with the name of the line at the end (for example “Ingresos Exp” belongs to the “Exp” line); the report discovers the lines by itself, with no fixed lists.
Cada línea trae los mismos 16 conceptos:: Each line carries the same 16 items: revenue, other and financial income, administration and sales expenses, depreciation and amortization (of cost and of expense), provisions, other expenses, financial expenses, exchange difference, income tax and cost of sales.
Solo se muestran las líneas con movimien: Only the lines with activity in the chosen range are shown.
<b>Línea de negocio y línea de venta.</b: Business line and sales line. When the model includes the columns LineaNegocio and LineaVenta, the business line comes from the first and the sales line (the “Type”) from the second. If the business line column is empty (older models) the name at the end of the account is used, as before. The analysis by sales line only appears if the company has data in LineaVenta.
<b>Empresa con una sola línea de negocio: Company with a single business line. Costs and expenses are not distributed between lines: they are taken from the Income statement (P&L) of the whole company, by item, and assigned in full to that single line. Revenue still comes from the lines model, so it matches the sum of the sales lines. The report says so with a footnote.
Costo de ventas (CMV) + depreciación del: Cost of sales (COGS) + depreciation of cost + amortization of cost.
Administración + ventas + depreciación y: Administration + sales + depreciation and amortization of expense + provisions for receivables and inventories.
Utilidad operacional + las cuatro deprec: Operating profit + the four depreciations and amortizations (cost and expense). The model has no EBITDA line.
Otros ingresos + ingresos financieros −: Other income + financial income − other expenses − financial expenses − exchange difference.
Utilidad operacional + resultado no oper: Operating profit + non-operating result − income tax.
Cada utilidad dividida por los ingresos: Each profit divided by the revenue of the same line (without revenue there is no margin).
El mismo rango de meses del año anterior: The same range of months of the previous year; if that year has no lines data, no variations are shown.
Ingresos de la línea de venta dividido p: Revenue of the sales line divided by the revenue of all the sales lines in the range.
Líneas de venta: aporte al cambio: Sales lines: contribution to the change
Variación en pesos de la línea frente al: Variation in pesos of the line against the previous year divided by the total revenue variation: how much of the growth (or the drop) that line explains.
Suma de la participación de las tres lín: Sum of the share of the three largest sales lines (shown only with more than three lines).
El mes del rango con mayor ingreso de es: The month of the range with the highest revenue of that line; “Months with sales” counts the months with non-zero revenue.
<b>Costos y gastos</b> vienen del modelo: Costs and expenses come from the model as positive values and the report subtracts them; they are not interpreted as negative signs.
Una franja verde indica que, para el mis: A green strip indicates that, for the same range, the revenue and net profit of all the lines added together match the Income statement (P&L) within a tolerance of one peso. If they do not match, the strip turns red and shows the difference: it is a signal to review how costs were assigned between lines or whether the Business Lines model and the P&L model were run with the same data.
El botón <b>Generar</b> produce tres lín: The Generate button produces three lines: Profitability (which line is the most and least profitable), Concentration (how much the business depends on a single line) and Recommended action. “Ask this report” answers free-form questions about these figures.
<b>Qué se envía a la IA:</b> únicamente: What is sent to the AI: only the already-calculated summary by line and the total; no detailed accounting data and nothing from other tables is sent.
Cuenta contra el presupuesto de IA de la: It counts against the company’s AI budget and respects per-user access; if AI is turned off for the company, the block does not appear.
Botón <b>Exportar</b>, igual que en los: Export button, the same as in the other reports, with the company logo and the chosen palette:
<b>Excel:</b> hojas «Resumen por línea»,: Excel: sheets “Summary by line”, “Statement by line” and “Monthly mix”; if there are sales lines, also “Sales lines” and “Sales lines mix”.
<b>PDF</b> horizontal: resumen con indic: Landscape PDF: summary with indicators, AI reading and comments; mix and margins; the income statement by line; and, if there are sales lines, a page with the share pie chart and the table.
<b>Copiar como imagen</b> y <b>Enviar po: Copy as image and Send by email (with the Excel and PDF attached; the sending is recorded in the audit log).
No veo líneas, ¿qué hago?: I do not see any lines, what do I do?
Ejecute el modelo de Líneas de Negocio d: Run the company’s Business Lines model in Model Execution and choose a range with data. If the company does not use lines, the report has nothing to show.
¿Por qué una línea no aparece?: Why does a line not appear?
Porque no tuvo movimiento (todo en cero): Because it had no activity (everything at zero) in the chosen range.
¿Por qué no veo costos ni márgenes por l: Why do I not see costs or margins by sales line?
Porque el modelo solo trae ingresos por: Because the model only brings revenue by sales line. Costs, expenses and margins are analyzed by business line.
Mi empresa tiene una sola línea de negoc: My company has a single business line, where do its costs and expenses come from?
Del Estado de resultados (PYG) de toda l: From the Income statement (P&L) of the whole company: being a single line, all the costs and expenses belong to it and are not broken down between lines.
¿Por qué no aparece el análisis por líne: Why does the analysis by sales line not appear?
Porque la empresa no tiene datos de líne: Because the company has no sales line data in the Business Lines model, or the model was run before that column existed: run it again in Model Execution.
¿Por qué la franja de cuadre sale en roj: Why is the match strip red?
Los totales de las líneas no coinciden c: The totals of the lines do not match the P&L. Check that both models were run for the same scenario and the same data load.
Porque la línea no tuvo ingresos en el r: Because the line had no revenue in the range: without revenue there is no margin.
¿Puedo comparar contra el presupuesto?: Can I compare against the budget?
Hoy no: el modelo de líneas no trae pres: Not today: the lines model does not carry a budget. The comparison is against the same range of last year.
Todos los usuarios con acceso a la empre: All users with access to the company; only the author or an administrator can edit or delete a comment.
Para el contador o analista financiero: For the accountant or financial analyst
